cmd.description: Locks the current channel (prevents @everyone from sending messages).

lock.title: Channel locked
lock.done: {channel} is locked. Members can't send messages here until it's unlocked.
lock.failed: An unexpected error occurred while trying to lock the channel. Check my permissions (I need 'Manage Channels').

cmd.description: Unlocks the current channel (allows @everyone to send messages again).

unlock.notLocked: {channel} is not explicitly locked (everyone can already send messages).
unlock.title: Channel unlocked
unlock.done: {channel} is unlocked. Members can talk here again.
unlock.failed: An unexpected error occurred while trying to unlock the channel. Check my permissions (I need 'Manage Channels').

cmd.description: Delete a specific amount of messages

purge.range: Please specify a number between 1 and 100.
purge.title: Messages Purged
purge.failed: An unexpected error occurred during message deletion. Note: Messages older than 14 days cannot be bulk deleted.

cmd.description: Post, update or preview the server rules message
cmd.post: Post the rules with the design saved on the dashboard
cmd.postChannel: Where to post them (default: the channel saved on the dashboard)
cmd.update: Change the posted rules message to the current rules and design
cmd.preview: Show the rules post only to you, without posting it

rules.mainOnly: The rules can only be posted from the main server.
rules.notLoaded: The saved settings are not loaded (database not responding). Nothing was changed.
rules.noChannel: No rules channel is saved. Pick one with the channel option, or save one on the dashboard Rules page.
rules.cannotSee: I cannot see that channel. Pick another one.
rules.channelGone: The saved rules channel no longer exists. Pick one with the channel option, or save another on the dashboard Rules page.
rules.saveFailed: Could not save the post (database not responding). {undone}
rules.postRefused: Discord refused the post. Nothing was posted.
rules.postUndone: The post was removed again. Nothing was changed.
rules.updateRefused: Discord refused the update. Some messages may already show the new rules. Try /rules update again.
rules.updateUndone: New extra messages were removed again and the saved post was not changed. Run /rules update again.
rules.notPosted: The rules have not been posted yet. Use /rules post first.
rules.earlierPost: The earlier post in <#{channelId}> stays where it is. Next time, use /rules update to change the post instead.
rules.updated: The posted rules in <#{channelId}> were updated ({messages}).
rules.previewHead: Preview of the rules post ({messages}, saved channel: {where}). Only you can see this. Nothing was posted.
